function: Learned excitation current weights and 3D positions of an 8-UAV virtual antenna array for collaborative beamforming; maximizes secrecy rate against a mobile eavesdropper, minimizes flight energy (p. 7-8).
system: 8 single-antenna rotary-wing UAVs forming a virtual array, 40 m x 40 m area, air-to-ground link to one remote BS, mobile ground eavesdropper, 2.4 GHz (p. 4-6, 10-11).
method: GDMTD3: TD3 with a diffusion-model actor (4 denoising steps) and twin MLP critics; reinforcement learning, training phase coordinated by the RBS, then execution on the swarm (p. 8-12).
data_channel: Own simulator: probabilistic LoS air-to-ground model [47] with path loss [48], Gauss-Markov eavesdropper mobility, 2.4 GHz; no dataset or measurement (p. 5-7, 10).
test_conditions: Training: 8000 episodes, 8 UAVs dispersed randomly in 40 m x 40 m, mobile eavesdropper. Also simulated with 4 to 16 UAVs; no unseen-setting transfer stated (p. 11-12, 15).
baselines: Non-learned: random, linear, planar and circular antenna array deployments. Learned: DDPG, TD3, SAC, PPO, transformer-based TD3 (p. 12-13).
metrics: Average secrecy rate per step (bps/Hz), average flight energy per step (J), reward per episode; effects of seeds, noise schedule, denoising steps, UAV number, phase error (p. 13-15).
complexity: Big-O of training and execution, e.g. execution O(MNT|theta_d|), space O(|theta_d|); symbolic parameter counts, no runtime or FLOPs (p. 11).
openness: none stated; supplementary material is cited only for Appendices A-D (motivation, proofs, phase-error model) (p. 1, 6-7, 15).
q1_support: p. 5: "we utilize the elevation angle-dependent probabilistic Line-of-Sight (LoS) model [47]"; custom simulator, no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 15: "we performed a detailed simulation under varying numbers of UAVs"; the paper never states a model trained on one setting and tested on another, and state and action sizes depend on the UAV number (p. 7-8).
q3_support: p. 12: "The random strategy arranges each UAV in a random position"; p. 13: "four well-known DRL benchmarks: DDPG, TD3, SAC [64], and PPO [65]", compared on secrecy rate and energy (Figs. 4 and 6).
q4_support: p. 11: "the computational complexity of GDMTD3 is O(M N T |θd |)"; the training-phase order is also given on p. 11.
q5_support: p. 1: "supplementary downloadable material available at https://doi.org/10.1109/TMC.2024.3502685"; p. 7: "please refer to the Appendix B of the supplementary material", so it holds appendices, and no code or dataset is stated.
notes: Area 6 by the tie-break order: beam control and placement of a UAV virtual array on an air-to-ground link. The objective is a secrecy rate against a mobile eavesdropper (physical-layer security), which is not a listed exclusion; reviewer to confirm. The learned action sets positions and excitation weights (p. 8), so it passes above_phy under the aerial-link rule. Supplement content is not in the PDF (q5).
